name: Tripura Sundari
first_frame: a front-facing, full-length portrait of Tripura Sundari at eye level, seated cross-legged on a golden lotus throne above calm dark water, both arms open to the sides with palms up, a tall jeweled crown with a crescent moon centered and fully framed, a gentle faint smile, a deep blue twilight sky fading to soft pink behind Her, and nothing else in the frame.

appearance.skin: warm golden-peach skin with a soft glow
appearance.eyes: large, warm, luminous eyes full of compassion
appearance.third_eye: a small jeweled mark at the brow
appearance.headwear: tall tiered gold crown set with rubies and pearls, topped with a jeweled crescent moon on a pearl finial
appearance.hair: long, wavy dark hair falling over the shoulders
attire: draped crimson silk bodice and shoulder wrap with a wide gold border
crimson silk trousers gathered at the ankles, with a gold-bordered drape across the lap
ornamentation: multi-strand pearl necklaces with ruby pendants
ruby and pearl armbands and stacked gold and ruby bangles
gold waist belt set with rubies and small bells

environment.sky: deep blue twilight sky fading to soft pink at the horizon, with a few faint stars
environment.lighting: soft twilight light with a gentle rose glow, lighting the face, crown and jewels
environment.ground: calm dark water with gentle ripples around a golden lotus throne

creative_palette.elemental_domain: calm dark water at twilight, a golden lotus throne, a soft rose glow
signature_phenomena: a soft rose-gold radiance rising slowly from Her form as She smiles
gentle ripples spreading slowly across the calm water around the lotus
a slow, warm smile that brightens Her glow
